positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building scalable and reliable systems for interactive query execution and results transformation on cloud data warehouses.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cloud Archival team, part of Rubrik's core data engine (Cerebro), designing scalable systems for enterprise data management across on-premises and cloud deployments. Developing mechanisms, primarily in Scala, for archival and recovery of backup data, managing data in cloud storage, and disaster recovery.

Led design and development of Smart Tiering for Azure, a novel mechanism for optimizing cloud storage costs across archival storage tiers (including cold storage), while maintaining incremental backup chains and instant recovery for critical backups.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineering intern for Cerebro, on Cloud Archival.

Added support for data archival to cold storage using Amazon Glacier with Vault Lock, providing cost-effective long-term data retention policies for legal compliance.

Designed efficient parallel data encryption methods for multithreaded archival uploads.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Responsibilities included presenting lectures on course content, supervising labs and tutorials, grading projects, assignments, and exams, and providing feedback and working with students to improve understanding of course material.

I have TAed the following courses:
CSC373: Algorithm Design, Analysis, and Complexity (advanced section, Winter 2017)
CSC263: Data Structures and Analysis (Fall 2016)
CSC263: Data Structures and Analysis (Winter 2016)
CSC207: Software Design (Fall 2015)
CSC263: Data Structures and Analysis (Winter 2015)
CSC207: Software Design (Fall 2014)

company.name: University of Toronto Department of Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineering Intern on machine learning for Video Search (Content Ranking). Projects included:
- Leveraging video transcripts generated via automatic speech recognition to improve video retrieval and ranking,
- Improving video ranking and training ranking models for newsy queries.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineering Intern applying machine learning for Risk Engineering. Main projects included:
- Automating training of lightweight models for low-latency payment fraud classification.
- Researched, developed methods for feature selection, data preprocessing and model training.
- Adapted machine learning algorithms to efficiently use data parallelization for massive datasets.
